self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 "The Silver Tongue": ATK is increased by 32% for 15s after being affected by Pyro (once every 12s).
R5 "The Silver Tongue": All Elemental DMG Bonus is increased by 24% for 15s after being affected by Hydro, Cryo, Electro, or Dendro (once every 12s).

en.flavor: Most people will find this obsidian-inlaid club quite convincing indeed.

refinements.1: ATK will be increased by <r>16%</r> for 15s after being affected by Pyro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. All Elemental DMG Bonus will be increased by <r>12%</r> for 15s after being affected by Hydro, Cryo, Electro, or Dendro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
refinements.2: ATK will be increased by <r>20%</r> for 15s after being affected by Pyro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. All Elemental DMG Bonus will be increased by <r>15%</r> for 15s after being affected by Hydro, Cryo, Electro, or Dendro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
refinements.3: ATK will be increased by <r>24%</r> for 15s after being affected by Pyro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. All Elemental DMG Bonus will be increased by <r>18%</r> for 15s after being affected by Hydro, Cryo, Electro, or Dendro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
refinements.4: ATK will be increased by <r>28%</r> for 15s after being affected by Pyro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. All Elemental DMG Bonus will be increased by <r>21%</r> for 15s after being affected by Hydro, Cryo, Electro, or Dendro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
refinements.5: ATK will be increased by <r>32%</r> for 15s after being affected by Pyro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. All Elemental DMG Bonus will be increased by <r>24%</r> for 15s after being affected by Hydro, Cryo, Electro, or Dendro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
